answer: Anchor each agent identity to a refundable stake plus a slowly earned reputation record: an agent must lock funds and complete verified work over time before it can trade at full limits. A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity, wait out the same history, and lose the stake if caught cheating. Like an onyx seal that cannot be copied cheaply, the record breaks the spiral of free identities: creating thousands of fakes costs thousands of stakes and months of work, while honest agents pay once.
